name: School of Conjuration
summary: Wizards who summon creatures and objects and teleport.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.short: Copy conjuration spells for half the time and gold.
features.summary: The gold and time you must spend to copy a conjuration spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Minor Conjuration
features.short: Action: conjure a small object for an hour.
features.summary: As an action, you conjure an inanimate object of up to 3 ft. and 10 lb. that you have seen, in your hand or on the ground within 10 ft. It lasts 1 hour or until it takes damage.

features.name: Benign Transposition
features.short: Action: teleport 30 ft. or swap places with an ally.
features.summary: As an action, you teleport up to 30 ft. or swap places with a willing Small or Medium creature within 30 ft. Recharges after a long rest or when you cast a conjuration spell of 1st level or higher.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.short: Damage can't break concentration on conjuration spells.
features.summary: While concentrating on a conjuration spell, taking damage can't break your concentration.

features.name: Durable Summons
features.short: Your summoned creatures gain 30 temp HP.
features.summary: Any creature you summon or create with a conjuration spell has 30 temporary hit points.
